description: This PHP script is part of the SuiteCRM installation process, handling configuration, database setup, table creation, relationship setup, default data population, and finalizing the installation with a completion page.

classes.name: TabController
classes.description: Manages the system tabs configuration during setup.

classes.name: Currency
classes.description: Represents currency data, used here to manage default currency during setup.

methods.name: installStatus
methods.description: Updates the status message of the installation and writes to a JSON file.

methods.name: handleSugarConfig
methods.description: Handles loading or saving SugarCRM configuration settings.

methods.name: handleWebConfig
methods.description: Configures web server settings for IIS environments.

methods.name: handleHtaccess
methods.description: Configures .htaccess or equivalent for URL rewriting.

methods.name: handleDbCreateSugarUser
methods.description: Creates the database user for SugarCRM.

methods.name: drop_table_install
methods.description: Drops a specified table during setup if drop tables is enabled.

methods.name: create_table_if_not_exist
methods.description: Creates a table for a module if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: updateUpgradeHistory
methods.description: Records the upgrade history after installation.

methods.name: installLog
methods.description: Logs the installation process steps and messages.
